column3: Close to the Hebrew; “graves are mine” is rendered “The grave is ready for me.”
The line is obscure; NKJV renders “for a portion he denounces friends” as “He who speaks flattery to his friends.”
Close to the Hebrew; חָנֵף (“the godless”) is rendered “the hypocrite.”
Close to the Hebrew; שְׁאוֹל (“Sheol”) is rendered “the grave.”
Close to the Hebrew; לַשַּׁחַת (“the pit”) is rendered “corruption,” and “maggot” “worm.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the bars of Sheol” is rendered “the gates of Sheol,” and “descend” “have rest.”
